Notes: Content that exists only with Cornucopia More Crops 1.6.3 and East Scarp 3.0.9 both installed: Cornucopia's daily trigger actions spawn its Peppercorn (Spring and Summer), Raspberry (Summer), Juniper Berries and Ube Seeds (Winter) groups on East Scarp maps when {{HasMod |contains=LemurKat.EastScarp}} holds ([CP] Cornucopia More Crops/data/forage.json, the _ES triggers at lines 341, 396 and 453 and the two East Scarp lines of the Ube Seeds trigger at 530). | Each is a daily RANDOM roll per map (10% to 25%), so every route is Chance, as the Cornucopia layer writes the same groups on vanilla maps; none gives a week. | The Meadow Farm lines also need the map to have been visited ({{HasVisitedLocation}}); the route says so in its detail. | East Scarp's own files never name Cornucopia.
